{{Quote|The ship isn't armed yet but there is an ''energy shield'' on the planet's surface protecting it. ''Captain Rex's'' team will knock out the shield generator and I'll lead the fighters as we fly ''inside'' and destroy its ''main generator''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Hotshot" />}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a '''battle''' took place in the [[Enoth system/Legends|Enoth system]] when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] mounted an offensive to destroy a [[Unidentified Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] under construction at the [[Unidentified Enoth system shipyards|Enoth system shipyards]].
